test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some facebook are WhatsApp.

All messenger are WhatsApp.

**Conclusions:**

I. All WhatsApp are messenger.

II. Some facebook are messenger.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follow.

solution:
Given Statements:

Some facebook are WhatsApp.

All messenger are WhatsApp.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f02d610c045a608411515ce61e517ad328967850ad306b731ed378199069c745.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All WhatsApp are messenger - False (Because, All messenger are WhatsApp implies that some WhatsApp are messenger, but All WhatsApp are messenger can be possible only).

II. Some facebook are messenger - False (Because, No definite relation given between facebook and messenger, so it can be possible only).

So, Neither conclusion I nor II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
